body:
## Why

`importGithubBoard` reads closed cards through `listClosedRecent({first: CLOSED_PAGE})`, and
`fetchClosedRecent` (`src/store/github.js`) is one GraphQL query with no `pageInfo` loop — its own
comment says *"One query, no paging"*. #294's review round made the cap **honest** (`closed_capped` and
`closed_page` in the import summary) but not **absent**: a board with more than 100 cards closed inside
the window still imports the 100 most recently updated and leaves the rest behind.

**Measured on this repository's own board, 2026-09-03**, which root C (#302) is scheduled to migrate:

| | |
|---|---|
| kb cards total | 188 |
| open | 57 |
| closed | 131 |
| closed inside the 90-day window | 131 |
| dropped by the 90-day window | **0** |
| dropped by the 100-card page cap | **31** |

So the window is not the problem here and the cap is: migrating this board today silently leaves 31
closed cards — their run records, their results, their handoffs — off the local store. The issues stay on
GitHub, so nothing is destroyed, but the local board becomes the source of truth without them, and
`next_id` is computed from the truncated set.

This is the last thing between the local store and migrating a real board, which is why it is filed
ahead of #302 rather than inside it.

## What

1. `fetchClosedRecent` paginates on `pageInfo.hasNextPage`/`endCursor` like the board query already
   does, until the window is exhausted rather than until a page is full. The 90-day filter stays: it is
   a deliberate scope, where the page size never was.
2. A ceiling that is reached is *reported*, not silently applied — keep `closed_capped`, and make it
   mean "there is more beyond what any window would take", not "the first page ran out".
3. `next_id` is computed after the full read.
4. Check the same shape elsewhere: `adoptOpenIssues` pages open issues to `pages` and warns; #294's
   review found its `more = page === pages` reports a false positive on an exact multiple. Fix that
   while here — a warning that cries wolf on a 1000-issue repo trains the reader to ignore it.

## Done when

- [ ] A fixture board with 250 cards closed inside the window imports all 250.
- [ ] `closed_capped` is false in that case, and true only when a real ceiling was hit.
- [ ] `adoptOpenIssues`'s `more` is false on an exact multiple of the page size.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` green.

## Contract

Do not migrate this repository's own board here (root C does that, and it is the reason this card
exists). Keep `src/gh.js` the only place that shells out to `gh`. `--json` everywhere; errors name the
fix and carry `.exitCode`.
title: hkb init --import silently drops closed cards past one page: 31 of this board’s 131 would not migrate
